# Gramlot examples 0.2.8

## Changes

- The pages, the gallery and the tests follow the proxies of the core 0.2.10: `this.page.renderer`, `this.page.source`, `this.page.builder` and `window.gramlot.renderer`, `.source`, `.builder` become `this.page.src.*` and `window.gramlot.src.*`. The examples behave as before.

## Requirements

Python 3.11 or later with `gramlot` 0.2.10 or later; Node.js 22 or later, or Bun, with `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.2.10 or later.
